DOTA_Crownfall_EncounterDesc_Minesweeper: Help Spleen clear the deadly minefield in the courtyard.
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_GameDesc: Help Spleen find all a path through all the mines. Instantly lose if you step on a mine.
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_HowToPlayDesc: Reveal spaces on the board without uncovering a mine. Any space not containing a mine will tell you how many mines are adjacent to it (diagonals included)
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_Reveal_Detail: Reveal all non-mine spaces to advance
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_Flag_Details: Flag a space to mark mines
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_Illusion_Deta: Echo Slash illusions can safely reveal mine spaces
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_ItemDrops_Det:
Clarity +{d:clarity_mana_amount} mana. Clock +{f:0:clock_timer_amount} seconds.
Note: Spaces are not guaranteed to be safe!
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_GreenSpace_De: There might be a mine here, or there might not.
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_NumberedSpace: Tells you how many mines surround it.
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_ChordLeftClic: Left-click on a revealed space to reveal all eight adjacent spaces if it has the correct number of flags
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_ChordRightCli: Right-click on a revealed space to flag all eight adjacent spaces if it has the correct number of hidden spaces
DOTA_Crownfall_Minesweeper_UseIllusion: Send Echo Slash illusion to reveal a space
DOTA_VisualNovel_act4_Dialogue_minesweep: You did it! I can see a path through.
Hey, wait a second! We agreed on ALL the mines for ten gold.
We don't care about ALL the mines. We just wanted a way into the castle.
But you SAID 'all' the mines. Plus they might come in handy!
...I'm starting to think it would be faster to let you than to argue about it.
Great! I'll just grab a few more then.
Ha ha, that was FUN! I wonder who I could get to pay me to replant these...
